title: Quantitative multispecies eDNA
description: Connecting qPCR and metabarcoding to estimate DNA concentrations across multiple species.
detail: A joint statistical model combines absolute abundance from a reference species with compositional metabarcoding data. Spatial smooths turn the estimates into maps, with a reproducible workflow for manuscript figures.
gesture: Move through the school to follow the fish.
metaphor: A fine-line school of fish, illustrating multispecies marine communities.

title: Smart eDNA sampling
description: Exploring how sampling effort shapes spatial prediction, and how to design more efficient eDNA surveys.
detail: Analysis code evaluates sampling effort with spatial models and simulations. An accompanying survey planner lets you explore the relationship between prediction error, sampling effort and survey area.
gesture: Move across the curve to explore a model prediction.
metaphor: An illustrative fitted curve with observations and uncertainty bounds, representing ecological models.

title: Air eDNA quantification
description: Investigating the transfer of environmental DNA from water into air through passive air sampling.
detail: Explore the R and Stan analysis scripts, field and laboratory data, posterior model outputs, figures and manuscript materials behind the study “Passive air sampling detects environmental DNA transfer from water into air”.
gesture: Move to turn the DNA strands above the water.
metaphor: A DNA helix above water, illustrating environmental DNA at the water–air interface.

title: qPCR & ddPCR: sensitivity and precision
description: Comparing how two PCR methods detect and quantify low concentrations of environmental DNA.
detail: Bayesian analyses of known DNA standards and environmental samples assess detection sensitivity and quantification precision for three teleost fish species assays. Includes the code and data supporting the research article.
gesture: A closer look at the laboratory.
metaphor: A laboratory microscope with a specimen slide and sample tubes, illustrating laboratory measurement.

title: Predicting trawl catches with eDNA
description: Bringing molecular observations and traditional trawl surveys together for fisheries research.
detail: Explore the repository accompanying “Predicting trawl catches using environmental DNA”, published in ICES Journal of Marine Science. The project connects eDNA observations with trawl catches.
gesture: Following the catch, from sea to survey.
metaphor: A fishing boat towing a mesh net containing fish beneath the water, illustrating a trawl survey.
